From iteration 1, I set revision to 1, change to "turn-1", counters.turns to 1. The note can be something like "initialized" or similar.

Now iteration 2: revision 2, change "turn-2", counters.turns 2.

Iteration 3: revision 3, change "turn-3", counters.turns 3.

Iteration 4: revision 4, change "turn-4", counters.turns 4.

I need to keep the JSON compact. So I'll output just the JSON object.

The prior object from iteration 1 was: {"revision":1,"change":"turn-1","counters":{"turns":1},"note":"initialized"}
